Worcester Heart Attack Study (WHAS100)

Source: R/data.R
Whas100.Rd

Follow-up data for 100 patients hospitalised with acute myocardial infarction, used to illustrate Cox proportional hazards and parametric survival models.

Usage

Whas100

Format

A data frame with 100 rows and 14 variables:

id

Subject identification number.

addate

Admission date to the hospital.

foldate

Follow-up date.

hosstay

Length of hospital stay (in days).

foltime

Follow-up time from hospital admission to follow-up date (in days).

folstatus

Vital status at follow-up (0 = alive, 1 = dead; event indicator).

age

Age at hospital admission (in years).

gender

Gender of the patient (0 = male, 1 = female).

bmi

Body Mass Index (kg/m\(^2\)).

agex

Age group (factor), derived from age via cutAge.

Source

https://stats.oarc.ucla.edu/stata/examples/asa2/

References

Hosmer, D. W., Lemeshow, S., & May, S. (2008). Applied Survival Analysis, 2nd ed. Wiley.
